posts.name: Dageno AI 2.0
posts.tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
posts.description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

posts.name: Databox CLI
posts.tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
posts.description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

posts.name: Product Hunt MCP
posts.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
posts.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

posts.name: Arcjet AI security models
posts.tagline: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents
posts.description: Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

posts.name: ProtoMap
posts.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies
posts.description: ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

posts.name: GitHub New PR Overview
posts.tagline: See what's blocking a PR before you scroll
posts.description: GitHub's new pull request overview page moves merge status to the top, with checks, approvals, comments, and next actions in one compact summary. It also adds unresolved-comment filters, newest-first sorting, and an activity panel.

posts.name: Higgsfield Miracle
posts.tagline: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest
posts.description: Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

posts.name: MCP1
posts.tagline: One URL for every MCP server.
posts.description: Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

posts.name: Pawse.ai
posts.tagline: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans
posts.description: Pawse.ai writes sound for your dog while it plays. Every session is shaped to how dogs hear. Choose Sleep, Home Alone, Loud Noise, Travel or Vet Visit. Tell it what your dog did and the next session adjusts. The Apple TV app keeps playing after you leave.

posts.name: Voyager
posts.tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
posts.description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

posts.name: Egoist AI Passport
posts.tagline: Secure and share your personal data with AI tools.
posts.description: AI Passport securely saves your personal data in one place, then lets you bring that context into the AI tools you use. Connect apps like Email, Calendar, ChatGPT, Claude, and more, choose exactly what data you want to share, and what you want to keep private, and revoke permissions whenever you want. Your AI tools get more personal, while your data stays yours.

posts.name: Jotform App for Shopify
posts.tagline: Build powerful forms for your Shopify store
posts.description: Bring Jotform’s powerful forms to your Shopify store. Create contact forms, lead forms, applications, registrations, surveys, and more. Match your store’s style, add conditional logic, calculations, and file uploads, and connect responses to the tools your team uses. Manage forms and submissions in Jotform, with your store as another place to reach customers.

posts.name: If You Read This
posts.tagline: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch
posts.description: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch. You check in by opening the app. If you miss your check-in and its reminders, your pre-written message is texted to the contacts you chose. For US and Canadian phone numbers.

posts.name: ClipsPal
posts.tagline: AI video editor that edits your talking-head videos
posts.description: Desktop video editor for Mac and Windows. Drop in raw clips: ClipsPal cuts failed takes and silences, adds zoom-ins, subtitles, visuals and sound, then turns the video into shorts and articles. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

posts.name: Sign Language by Panda Video
posts.tagline: Add a sign language interpreter to videos already online
posts.description: Upload a video of your sign language interpreter and link it to any video you've already published. Viewers turn the interpreter window on from the player, then move and resize it. Everyone else watches as usual. No re-editing, no re-uploading.

posts.name: CozyZip
posts.tagline: Zip and unzip without the surprises.
posts.description: Preview, create and extract archives on your Mac, in Terminal or through local MCP tools. Free lifetime personal licence with verified email. Commercial use is US$5 once per person on up to three Macs. macOS 26+, Apple Silicon.

posts.name: Watchflows
posts.tagline: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in
posts.description: Stop doing the same Mac chores by hand. Watchflows runs them the moment something happens: a file lands in Downloads, you press a hotkey, a webhook arrives, it's 8:30 on a weekday. Wire triggers, conditions, actions and AI on a canvas, or describe it in plain English and the Flow Builder assembles it. AI reads, renames and decides mid-flow, on Watchflows AI, Apple's on-device model, Ollama, or your own keys. Local-first, no account. 14-day free trial, then $49 once. Also on Setapp.

posts.name: Calmly Script
posts.tagline: Beautiful screenwriting software. Pay once, no sign-up
posts.description: Professional screenwriting software with a clean, beautiful interface: industry-standard pages, Final Draft files, an open format. No account, no tracking. Pay once. Windows, Mac, Linux, Android.

posts.name: Nörth
posts.tagline: Natural, peer-to-peer collaboration for remote work
posts.description: Nörth brings remote teams together with spatial voice chat, drop-in rooms, and voice and video messaging. Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted, and native to macOS.

posts.name: Cardboard AI
posts.tagline: Best way to edit videos with AI
posts.description: Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.

posts.name: Flic Cue
posts.tagline: The AI Voice Button: hold to talk, shake to undo, open SDKs
posts.description: Get your thoughts out of your head and into the right place, without picking up your phone or touching the keyboard. Say it, and Cue files it in your lists, calendar, notes or reminders, or hands bigger jobs to ChatGPT, Claude or your own agent. At your computer, what you say is typed in for you. Shake Cue to undo, swipe it right to copy the text instead, and give your coding agent its next instruction by voice. You decide what each push, swipe and shake does.

posts.name: KIKUmap
posts.tagline: A mind map for your Claude and ChatGPT chats
posts.description: A macOS menu-bar app and desktop widget: see which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting for you, and arrange them as a mind map. Free and open source.

posts.name: Cue
posts.tagline: AI meeting notes, prep
posts.description: An AI crew for macOS that helps you in meetings: they prepare you before a call, take the notes and guide you during it, and draft the follow-ups after. Between meetings, they type what you say in any app and answer about what is on your screen.

posts.name: skuttr
posts.tagline: Type one sentence, get a Reel from your camera roll
posts.description: skuttr turns one sentence into a ready-to-post Reel. Type “Tokyo solo trip” and it finds the right photos and videos on your iPhone, puts the strongest shot first and has a vertical Reel ready in under a minute. Your first 5 Reels are free.

posts.name: Terse - Durable Actors
posts.tagline: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products
posts.description: We provide an army of tiny servers to help you build incredible and cost efficient Multiplayer AI at scale. It's an open source alternative to Cloudflare's Durable Objects. Each resource or agent gets it's own micro-vm with a co-located SQLite DB. It can only process one request at a time making it concurrency safe. Onboard each one, is a websocket server. Allowing clients of any form to connect and listen for events on the resource.

posts.name: Reduck
posts.tagline: Fast, reliable web access for your AI agents and n8n
posts.description: Reduck gives your AI agents and n8n workflows fast, reliable access to any website. Instead of clicking through a site step by step and burning tokens, your agent writes a script once, then reuses it: 0 tokens per run, up to 3x faster, same structured output every time. Use it from Claude, Codex or any MCP client, or as an n8n node for sites with no API, like LinkedIn, Discord or Reddit. Scripts run in your own Chrome, in the sessions you're already logged into.

posts.name: Lingoken
posts.tagline: The activity maker for language teachers
posts.description: Language teachers spend hours every week creating activities that students will want to work through. Lingoken helps them create these in the form of short fun games making learning a language feel like play. Using AI to generate the material, the activities can be customised to the students' level, target exam, or immigration requirements. Teachers can focus on their lesson plan and leave the practice to Lingoken. These activities can also be played during class for some fun group engagement.

posts.name: CookieYes for Shopify
posts.tagline: Built for Shopify cookie consent in your admin. 100% free.
posts.description: A Google-certified CMP, rebuilt for Shopify and now “Built for Shopify” certified. Region-aware cookie banners, auto-blocking, consent logs and Consent Mode v2, managed from your Shopify admin. All the essential cookie consent features, including the advanced ones, are free.

posts.name: TGMini
posts.tagline: Build a mini site behind a button in your Telegram channel
posts.description: TGMini puts a mini site behind a Menu button in your pinned Telegram post. Arrange links, image cards, text and video blocks in any order. Readers open your page inside Telegram or on the web. On a paid site, they can send you a message; you can reply right in the bot. Track visits and link clicks in your dashboard. Start with a free site, then upgrade for more links and reader messages.

posts.name: Claimr
posts.tagline: A free giveaways alert system
posts.description: Free game radar and instant giveaway alert system tracking Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Prime Gaming, PlayStation, and Xbox.

posts.name: Daily Scripture with Tennessee Tim
posts.tagline: A one-minute daily Scripture devo with Tennessee Tim
posts.description: A little Scripture. A little reflection. A moment of prayer. Daily Scripture with Tennessee Tim walks through Proverbs — all 344 episodes, in order — in about a minute an episode, from the Douay-Rheims Catholic Bible. Two new episodes arrive daily at 5 AM and 5 PM Central. At tim.mrbray.com, a Passport lets you stamp each episode as you listen — no account, stamps live on your device. Have a blessed day.

posts.name: AgentPark
posts.tagline: Multiplayer AI workspace with one company brain
posts.description: Bringing people and AI agents together to collaborate, share knowledge, and create in one connected workspace. http://agentpark.si

posts.name: TraceTUI
posts.tagline: Interactive TUI log debugger built with Textual
posts.description: Stop wasting time running multiple tail -f windows. TraceTUI brings a beautiful, multi-panel interactive terminal interface to parse, merge, and filter your logs in real-time.

posts.name: Pharon
posts.tagline: Security incident alerts for your whole stack
posts.description: Pharon is a warning system for software teams. It keeps an inventory of every package, container image, GitHub Action, runtime and cloud service you run, and alerts you within minutes when a compromised release, an exploited vulnerability, a vendor breach or an end-of-life deadline reaches it.

posts.name: MANTIS
posts.tagline: Inspect website trackers, data flows, and consent behavior
posts.description: MANTIS turns browser traffic into actionable analytics, privacy, and martech intelligence. Capture live network requests, reconstruct the causal chain behind tags and requests, and identify the tools and vendors involved. Inspect request details, analyze consent signals, and compare behavior before and after consent. Capture evidence stays local. Export findings into audit reports. Built for analysts, developers, and privacy practitioners. Free plan. In beta.

posts.name: Say It Again
posts.tagline: AI UGC videos from your product pages, now in ChatGPT
posts.description: Say It Again reads your product page and makes an AI UGC video: a generated presenter holds, uses or wears your product and speaks a script written from the page. On a paid plan, connect your account to ChatGPT and ask for a video there.

posts.name: iSha.re
posts.tagline: Shorten a link. No account, no monthly cap.
posts.description: Paste a URL and get a short link that stays until you delete it. No account, and no monthly cap on the site. The list stays in this browser, so you can copy, share, rename, or set one link to delete itself. The eye on a row shows visitors over the last 30 days. From code, one POST creates the same short link, with no API key.

posts.name: Chord
posts.tagline: A CRM for creatives that protects your boundaries
posts.description: Chord gives your clients one branded portal for proposals, contracts, invoices, files and feedback. It also protects your boundaries by preventing scope creep, and helps you beat the feast-or-famine cycle with forecasts for your workload and income.

posts.name: Runlight
posts.tagline: Stop renting your website analytics.
posts.description: Runlight is free, open source analytics that runs inside your own app. No third-party script, no monthly bill, no handing visitor data to someone else’s servers. Drop it into WordPress, Craft CMS, Drupal, or almost any stack (Node, PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, and more), and you get clean, privacy-friendly stats you actually own.

posts.name: TILANG
posts.tagline: A 3D scooter race in Bali where every plate is a math sum
posts.description: Race a scooter through Canggu, Bali. Overtake riders, read their license plate in your mirror (7x8, 12+9) and answer first to give them a "tilang", a ticket. Daily Ride and 8-player rooms. Free on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: PasteNotch
posts.tagline: Clipboard history in your Mac’s notch
posts.description: PasteNotch keeps copied text, links, images and files in a searchable library that opens from your Mac’s notch or ⇧⌘V. Pin favorites, organize projects with Pages and paste back into your work. Local by default. macOS 14+, with or without a notch. Free for 14 days with sign-in, then $4.99 once. Optional Cloud is $4.99/month with 25 GB and adds screenshots, OCR, recording, Screenshot Studio, sharing and a web library.

posts.name: Telltale Bot
posts.tagline: Bot and Agent Detection
posts.description: Telltale Bot tells you whether website visits come from a person, an AI agent acting for a person, or a bot. It names the agents it recognizes, like ChatGPT agent, Claude, Grok, and Meta Muse. Add one JavaScript tag, and the verdict is recorded and returned to the page. It flags visits instead of dropping them, so you can make your own decisions on how to filter or segment. Comes with a 14-day free trial, no card. Plans start at $20 a month.

posts.name: ChalkTalk
posts.tagline: Narrated tutorial videos you can edit scene by scene
posts.description: Turn complex technical topics into narrated tutorial videos with editable scenes. ChalkTalk transforms your content into visual explanations using code, diagrams, charts, terminal sessions, and math. Edit any scene or sentence and preview the result without recording again. Create videos in the web editor or directly through MCP using Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or Cursor. Free during early access, with support for your own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and more.

posts.name: AntiBridge
posts.tagline: Find your online exposure and what to fix next
posts.description: AntiBridge connects the public profiles, breach signals, and online traces associated with you, then organizes them into an exposure report with practical privacy actions. Start with a free profile search, confirm the right identity, and decide if the deeper report is worth it.

posts.name: MeetCap
posts.tagline: Free, local-first AI meeting notetaker that actually works
posts.description: Record any meeting free, with no time limit. MeetCap transcribes on your computer, explains new terms as they come up during the meeting, and has the minutes ready when it ends. Your AI agent can run it, query past meetings as context, and it works both way too. MeetCap can drive your local harness to write context-aware minutes.

posts.name: ClarityVerify
posts.tagline: People Search & Reverse Lookup Tools
posts.description: ClarityVerify is an online search platform that provides lookup tools to help users explore publicly available information associated with different identifiers.

posts.name: Graceup
posts.tagline: The social app that makes you more grateful
posts.description: A daily gratitude journal you can share with friends, family or the world. Write one good moment a day, see what made people smile around the world and keep your streak going. Post publicly, share with a private group or keep it just for you.

posts.name: Trinkets: Trip Collages
posts.tagline: Save the little moments
posts.description: Life moves fast. Trinkets helps you slow down and collect the little moments. Make a trip, add your photos, and Trinkets does the rest. It cuts out the people, pets and little things in each photo, right on your iPhone, and arranges them into one collage for the whole trip. No fiddly editing, no templates.

posts.name: Hal
posts.tagline: Your AI finance co-founder
posts.description: Hal is your AI finance co-founder that does your company finances, sends you monthly board reports, and talks with you to help you make all the difficult business decisions.

posts.name: Eventonite
posts.tagline: Flat fee music scene ticketing, no commission on the tickets
posts.description: Ticketing for clubs, gigs and festivals with no % commission. One flat monthly fee from USD 29. Ticket money goes straight to your own Stripe. Scan at the door on any device. Free for 30 days or your first 500 paid tickets, no card needed.

posts.name: vizeo
posts.tagline: The machines are grading your site
posts.description: 🚀 Supercharge Your Website’s SEO, AI Visibility & Security Struggling to rank on search engines or wondering how new AI agents like ChatGPT and Perplexity perceive your website? Meet VIZEO. 📈 SEO & Online Visibility ⚡ Page Speed & Core Web Vitals 🛡️ Web Security & Compliance ⚖️ Market & Brand Comparison 🎯 WHO IS THIS FOR? • Website Owners & Founders looking for an edge • Digital Marketers & Content Creators • SEO Specialists & Web Developers • E-commerce Brands keeping up with AI search trends

posts.name: FormSecured
posts.tagline: Forms agents and humans can create and fill
posts.description: Most forms require an agent to spin up a browser, or use an open one. We make forms agent fillable by default. Your agent can build a form and see responses, all over mcp. Your agent can respond to forms without having to spin up a browser.

posts.name: Veya
posts.tagline: Free period and symptom tracking, with no premium tier
posts.description: Keep period dates, symptoms, mood and notes together, then turn your entries into a one-page PDF for an appointment. Veya is free on Android and the web, with no ads or premium tier. No account is needed to start. Health entries stay on-device by default; sync, backup and sharing are optional. Usage analytics can be switched off. Predictions are estimates, not diagnosis or contraception. Try the sample-data demo.

posts.name: Click me a Startup 2
posts.tagline: Can you build a Startup in 365 days one click at a time?
posts.description: You have 365 in-game days to turn a solo coding gig into a software company. Write code, hire developers and AI agents, and ship projects to earn revenue. Grow too fast and tech debt and payroll can catch up with you. Play in your browser.

posts.tagline: Convert foreign prices with your camera, even offline
posts.description: Point your camera at a price tag, menu, or receipt to see an estimate in your own currency. Kahei reads one printed price at a time and works offline from your first scan with built-in reference rates. You can also type an amount and revisit recent scans. Free on iPhone and Android, with no ads or account.

posts.tagline: Like Claude Code for voice AI, from 2¢/min

Create an agent by talking to Zeus, or import one from Vapi, Retell, Bland or ElevenLabs.

Outage case studies turn real postmortems into lessons, and a coding track lets you step through each algorithm as the code runs. Most of it is free. Premium adds an interview script for every design and courses on Frontend System Design and AI Engineering.

posts.tagline: Temples in Cambodia: Map, Tickets & Guides
posts.description: Explore Cambodian temples, Angkor monuments, tickets, maps, and visitor guides.

posts.name: Pharma Stock Radar™
posts.tagline: Bring medicine and shortage intelligence into one view!
posts.description: Explore medicine records, shortages, and generic relationships in one workspace. Pharma Stock Radar helps pharmacies research related products, distributors investigate supply issues, and hospital buyers prioritize procurement follow-up.

posts.name: Peekaboo
posts.tagline: Finder alternative for Mac — find anything in plain English
posts.description: Finder shows you folders. Peekaboo shows you your Mac — every file as one calm library. Press Cmd-F and type in plain English: “pdfs from last week over 5 MB” becomes visible filters. It reads text inside screenshots and PDFs on-device, groups downloads by source, and finds duplicates. Clean Up finds forgotten downloads, unused apps and big videos — every cleanup undoable in one click. Files never leave your Mac. No account. Free 14 days. Launch sale: $9.99 until Nov 13, then $24.99 one-time.

posts.name: Moftgate
posts.tagline: On-Premises Endpoint Management & DLP - Free for first year
posts.description: Stop juggling 5 security tools. On-prem, hybrid or SaaS. Free tier for up to 200 endpoints.

posts.name: Chronos Gateway
posts.tagline: The firewall between AI agents and your production data
posts.description: AI agents have already wiped production databases. Chronos Gateway is how you let yours write to real customer data anyway. Every agent gets a run token, never your Postgres password, and a private copy of one customer's rows. Safe changes merge back in one transaction, every row checked against live data. Deletes and big changes stop and wait for a human, who approves in plain English. Your row-level security still decides what it can write. Self-hosted. Free. Postgres 12-18, Supabase, Neon.

posts.name: Branda
posts.tagline: AI-assisted Brand Asset Management
posts.description: Branda syncs your brand folder into a side panel that follows you into every tool: logos, colors, fonts, brand voice, graphics, icons — searchable, one click to copy, always the current version. Import a Stitch ZIP, steal your own hex codes back, ship without tab-hopping.

posts.name: emcee
posts.tagline: macOS Stage Manager alternative

Create an unlimited number of stages, one for each activity (e.g. gaming, work or study), and drag-drop windows between stages freely. The interface is fluid, and is more approachable than tiling window managers that require memorization of complicated keyboard shortcuts.

posts.name: Tfaddalu: Level A2
posts.tagline: Spoken Palestinian Arabic, now through level A2
posts.description: Tfaddalu teaches the Palestinian Arabic spoken in Jerusalem and Ramallah, with native audio on every word and review timed to your memory. Level A2 adds 15 units, 67 lessons and 316 words: shopping, driving, travel, weather and telling someone what happened.

posts.name: Cognition SWE-2 Flash
posts.tagline: Cognition’s fast coding model, 3x the speed of SWE-2
posts.description: SWE-2 Flash is Cognition’s new coding model, built on Thinking Machines’ Inkling-Small with 276B total and 12B active parameters. Per Cognition, it generates about 200 tokens per second, 3x the speed of SWE-2 at one-fifth the price, and scores 20.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, up from 0.9% for the base model. Try it in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, free through 11/30. Weights are not public yet.

posts.name: Altitude
posts.tagline: Keyword ranks, competitors and reviews for your app
posts.description: Paste your App Store or Google Play link. Altitude picks your keywords and competitors, tracks your ranks, and shows what to fix from your reviews and screenshots. Free for one app, Pro is $5 a month.

posts.name: Tamamon Focus
posts.tagline: A focus timer that helps your virtual pet grow
posts.description: Make time for one task, with a little company. Tamamon Focus pairs a mobile focus timer with a virtual pet that grows as you focus. Earn seeds through focused time, decorate your pet's room, and meet more companions along the way.

posts.name: Cognition SWE-2 Flash
posts.tagline: Cognition’s fast coding model, 3x the speed of SWE-2
posts.description: SWE-2 Flash is Cognition’s new coding model, built on Thinking Machines’ Inkling-Small with 276B total and 12B active parameters. Per Cognition, it generates about 200 tokens per second, 3x the speed of SWE-2 at one-fifth the price, and scores 20.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, up from 0.9% for the base model. Try it in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, free through 11/30. Weights are not public yet.

posts.name: ArchFlow
posts.tagline: Open-source AI architect: from requirements to code
posts.description: ArchFlow is an open-source, self-hosted AI system architect. Import a PRD or meeting transcript and get traceable requirements, AI-proposed architectures you compare and record as ADRs, and low-level designs for every component: APIs, tables, events and diagrams. Check health, cost and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS), then generate Terraform, Kubernetes, tests and specs, and hand the design to Claude Code and other agents over MCP. Your team edits it live, with branches and reviews.

posts.name: ToolSlash
posts.tagline: 1000+ Browser-based calculators, converters, and media tools
posts.description: ToolSlash is a free web utility platform built for speed and privacy. We provide over 935 (more coming soon) everyday tools in a single place. You can convert files, edit media, and calculate numbers instantly. Every tool runs locally inside your browser. We never upload your files to our servers. We track zero telemetry. You get fast, reliable results without risking your personal data. Stop hunting for single-use websites. Get your daily tasks done in seconds.

posts.name: MediaPlace
posts.tagline: One library for your photos, videos and design files
posts.description: MediaPlace keeps every photo, video and design file in one library and finds any of them when you describe it. Share folders as pages with your logo and colors, collect files from clients with one link, publish a brand page with your logos, colors and fonts, and turn photos into videos. Free to start with 15 GB.

posts.name: Pocket Compiler: Run Code
posts.tagline: Run Python, JavaScript, SQL & Java on your phone — offline
posts.description: Pocket Compiler runs real code on Android and iPhone without a laptop or internet. Write and run Python (with numpy and pandas),JavaScript and React, HTML, SQL on a real SQLite database, and Java for free; C, C++ and PHP are available with Pro on Android. Clone a GitHub repo and run it, use a built-in terminal and SSH, or type a code from our YouTube Shorts to open and run the exact program from the video. Your code stayson your phone.

posts.name: Game of the Day
posts.tagline: Every game ranked, nothing spoiled
posts.description: Watch only the games worth your time, without spoiling the result. Our algorithm weighs 70+ data points to rate every game in your favorite leagues, starting with the NBA. Open the site, check each game's rating out of 100. Built for fans who want to watch on replay without spoilers. If you're overseas, in a different time zone, or just busy when the games are on, you can still watch the Game of the Day without wasting your time on blowouts or low quality games.

posts.name: RIPEN
posts.tagline: Your whole year as one tree, a leaf for every day you keep
posts.description: A habit tracker that draws your habits as one tree. Every marked day grows a leaf, 66 leaves on a branch grow a fruit, and a habit you cut stays on the tree as a stub. The tree stands in a living world — real sun, real moon, real weather. Rain, snow and fog come and go, the seasons turn, and 5,044 stars stand in their true places for your date and hour, worked out from your time zone, not your location. No account, no analytics, no subscription.

posts.name: Wizstar viral-video-recreation
posts.tagline: Turn Viral Videos into Your Product Ads
posts.description: Wizstar’s Viral Video Recreation helps creators and marketers turn proven viral formats into engaging product videos. Simply upload a product and choose a high-performing video as a reference. Wizstar AI analyzes its structure, shots, pacing, and background music, then recreates the format with your product in one click. No need to start from scratch or experiment with different creative approaches. Create videos in minutes and scale production with proven formats.

posts.name: The Book Recommendation Box
posts.tagline: Pick a recommendation, leave one behind!
posts.description: Think of it as a little free library, but for book recommendations: a simple, welcoming space where readers can share their favourite reads and discover new ones. The goal is to bring back the joy of pure discovery: stepping outside my usual reading habits, exploring new genres, and discovering authors and stories you might never have come across otherwise. Because sometimes, the best book recommendations come from people, not algorithms.

posts.name: Keydrop
posts.tagline: Self-hosted license keys & promo codes on Cloudflare
posts.description: Keydrop is a free, MIT-licensed tool for indie developers to manage and hand out redemption codes, discount codes and license keys. Deploy it to your own Cloudflare account in one click (Workers + D1). Import or generate codes, run claim campaigns, hand out codes from your phone, sell one code per purchase with Stripe (revoked on refund), activate license keys per device, and connect it all with an API, webhooks and an MCP server. 8 languages, dark mode.

posts.name: VisaPhotos.app
posts.tagline: Passport and visa photos checked against official rules
posts.description: Check or make a passport, visa or ID photo for 151 documents in 90+ countries. The free checker runs in your browser, so your photo is never uploaded. The photo tool crops to the official size and head position, with a free preview and $4.99 to download.

posts.name: FelixCal
posts.tagline: The menu bar calendar your Mac forgot.
posts.description: Click the date in your menu bar: month grid, what's up next, reminders. Type "Lunch tomorrow 1pm" to add events, join Zoom/Meet/Teams in one click, edit in place. No account, no analytics, no subscription. $6.99 once, 3 Macs.

posts.name: IntentSignal Daily
posts.tagline: The AI SDR that emails companies the week they need you
posts.description: An AI SDR that finds companies the week they need you, writes a one-to-one email about what happened, and sends up to 40 a day from your inbox. $129/mo, 7-day trial.

posts.name: Retrolife
posts.tagline: Life Simulator Through Real Decades
posts.description: Live a whole life year by year in the real 1950s–2010s of the USA, Germany or the USSR. Real news, era prices, family and heirs. A text life sim for iPhone.

posts.name: SessionPlug
posts.tagline: ⁠Record, direct, edit and deliver audio in one browser tab
posts.description: SessionPlug brings remote recording, live direction, editing, mixing and delivery into one browser-based workspace. Guests join from a link, with nothing to install. CleanSync captures the clean audio directly on the artist's machine and keeps it aligned with the session, so you can focus on the work instead of juggling tools.

posts.name: Quoteo
posts.tagline: Invoicing and business management for French freelancers
posts.description: Quoteo simplifies invoicing and business management for French freelancers and self-employed professionals. Create quotes and invoices, track payments, automate reminders, and monitor revenue and URSSAF contributions, all in one easy-to-use platform.

posts.name: Word Solitaire
posts.tagline: A calm word puzzle played with solitaire-style letter cards
posts.description: Spell words from letter cards to clear the table. Play 50 free browser deals and a fresh daily puzzle, with no timer, account or ads. Unlimited undo and six languages let you play at your own pace. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: Tarca
posts.tagline: A space for all your work
posts.description: Tarca keeps projects, customers, documents, and next steps connected—from the first idea or inquiry through delivery. Plan tasks, manage CRM and sales, create and sign documents, build forms, review designs, publish web pages, and automate workflows. AI Meeting Notes provides transcripts, summaries, and action items you can turn into tasks. Use Tarca in your browser or download the Mac and Windows desktop application. Take a moment to explore the public demo at https://tarca.app/demo

posts.name: Pixicons
posts.tagline: Pixel icons with personality. Ideal for your project.
posts.description: 1200+ free icons in 2 variants and 15 awesome styles. All drawn by hand on a 11x11 grid. Add one tiny script and drop them straight into your HTML with classes or grab the PNG/SVG.

posts.name: XSplit Broadcaster
posts.tagline: Live streaming and recording software for Windows
posts.description: Live streaming and recording software for Windows. Combine camera, screen or game capture, media and webpages in scenes. Live Captions turns spoken English into captions for Twitch and YouTube Live. Free and Premium plans.
